name: Brodgar UI
author: brodgar
description: The minimap in a bare panel you drag and size anywhere, the chat as a window with a tab per channel, Ctrl+Space to find any action by name and run it, an action bar for every page of the belt, the client in the Simple theme, a key that hides the kinds of object you tick, the footprint of every object drawn on the ground, as many items out of a stockpile as you type in one press, and several characters played at once, switched with one click.
